rows.damages-a-player-by-their-untapped-lands: Oracle: at each player's upkeep Power Surge deals damage equal to the untapped lands that player controlled at the beginning of the turn. Observed: p1 (two untapped Forests at turn start) stays at 20 life through p1's upkeep to main phase; Power Surge also deals p0 no damage at p0's own upkeep with three untapped Forests. The script's count NumPowerSurgeLands has no reader in gorge; Forge reads it (forge-game AbilityUtils, Player, PhaseHandler) and counts at the turn's start.
